description: This file defines a static utility class 'ThemeHelper' for managing theme settings in a Windows UWP application, including getting/setting the root theme, initializing theme from saved settings, and registering/unregistering theme change callbacks.

classes.name: ThemeHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods for theme management, including getting/setting the root theme, initializing theme from saved settings, and callback registration.

classes.name: ThemeHelper.ThemeChangedCallbackToken
classes.description: A struct holding a weak reference to the root frame and a callback token for theme change event handling.

methods.name: RootTheme
methods.description: Property to get or set the application's root theme, with persistence in local settings.

methods.name: GetEnum
methods.description: Generic method to parse a string into an enum value of type TEnum.

methods.name: InitializeAppTheme
methods.description: Initializes the app theme based on saved user preferences.

methods.name: RegisterAppThemeChangedCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for theme change events on the root frame.

methods.name: UnregisterAppThemeChangedCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered theme change callback.
